description: Publicly traceable C/C++ storage, fabric, and BMC defect cases. The manifest is safe to stage for an agent; scoring answers live only in oracles/.

cases.title: NVMe/RDMA reset does not complete after a reconnect-time link flap

revision.note: The public issue is still open; the corpus snapshot is used only as an analysis target, not claimed as the defective revision.

cases.agent_input: 执行 /mr-regression。公开材料：SPDK NVMe/RDMA 的 Issue 链接与本地 SPDK 仓。围绕 controller reset 与链路短暂中断期间的 reconnect 分析回归边界；给出黑盒优先的测试场景、观测和恢复验证。不要读取 benchmarks/oracles。

cases.title: NVMe/TCP receive error paths retain working PDUs

revision.note: The public issue is still open; no confirmed upstream fix commit is recorded.

cases.agent_input: 执行 /module-analysis，分析 SPDK NVMe/TCP 接收错误与连接关闭路径。公开材料：Issue 链接和本地 SPDK 仓。输出资源守恒、异常恢复和长稳风险的黑盒测试建议；必要时提出系统级插桩需求，不生成插桩代码。不要读取 benchmarks/oracles。
